map.不一定；过大热影响区宽、变形大、易过热，过小则可能未熔合；高强钢、不锈钢需控在中: Not necessarily; too much widens the heat-affected zone, increases distortion and overheating, too little may lack fusion; high-strength steel and stainless steel should be controlled at the lower-middle range.

map.焊接热输入（本页代码口径）：E=U×I×η×60÷v（J/cm，U 电压 V、I: Weld heat input (as coded on this page): E = U×I×η×60/v (J/cm; U voltage V, I current A, η thermal efficiency, v travel speed cm/min, ×60 converts to minutes); derived values: kJ/cm = E/1000, kJ/mm = E/10000, arc power P = U×I (W). Validation: any non-numeric parameter, current/voltage/speed ≤ 0, or thermal efficiency η outside 0–1 shows 'enter valid parameters' and aborts. Criterion: bands by E (kJ/mm) — < 1.5 low heat input (thin plate/root pass against cold cracking), < 3.0 medium, < 6.0 relatively high (thick plate/SAW), otherwise high (grain coarsening).
